paragraphs: BatOnRoute is a bus route tool that brings management, planning and real-time tracking of routes into one place. The page describes running public or school transport services with it. Corporate commuting is a second use, framed around tracking routes and cutting unnecessary journeys.

Operators can locate each bus in real time, receive automatic notifications about its status, and manage routes from a single platform. Route duration and vehicle speed are monitored. Notifications are sent when passengers board and get off. The company says no additional GPS installation is needed and the existing transport provider does not have to change.
One testimonial on the page is attributed to a school transport coordinator. The site states that BatOnRoute is a product of Grupo Nunsys.

quote.text: Batonroute es una solución del Grupo Nunsys.
